# Sakura artwork

These are original generated theme decorations: muted rose blossoms, dark branches and wood/lacquer textures. They contain no functional icons, text or copied game screens.

Transparent pieces use a green (`#00ff00`) key background converted to RGBA. `RetainedAssetImage` displays them at fixed logical sizes. Material textures remain opaque.

| Asset | Source size | Display size |
|---|---|---|
| Sidebar branch | 792×1160 | Up to 198×290 |
| Title ornament | 840×160 | 168×32 |
| Section ornament | 320×72 | 80×18 |
| Three queue ornaments | 432×240 each | 54×30 |
| Cedar and plum lacquer | 1254×1254 each | Cover the surface |

## Design notes

Use dark umber branches, muted rose petals and simple silhouettes. Leave space around text. Keep edges transparent on ornaments. Textures use subtle grain, soft light and restrained bevels. No lettering, watermarks or interface elements.

These notes summarize the original prompts; they are not verbatim prompt records.
